description: This is a test script for the FastAPI application, specifically testing admin authentication endpoints such as registration, login, and fetching admin info. It uses pytest and FastAPI's TestClient to perform integration tests, setting up environment variables and utilizing fixtures.

methods.name: Generator[TestClient,None,None] app_client()
methods.description: Pytest fixture that initializes and yields a FastAPI TestClient with environment setup for testing admin endpoints.

methods.name: admin_register(client: TestClient, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Function to register an admin user via POST request to /admin/auth/register.

methods.name: admin_login(client: TestClient, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Function to login an admin user via POST request to /admin/auth/login.

methods.name: admin_me(client: TestClient, token: str)
methods.description: Function to retrieve current admin info via GET request to /admin/me with Bearer token.

methods.name: admin_list_admins(client: TestClient, token: str)
methods.description: Function to retrieve list of admins via GET request to /admin/admins with Bearer token.

methods.name: test_admin_register_login_me_and_list(app_client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test function that verifies the admin registration, login, detail retrieval, and list endpoints, including negative tests for authentication.

ctags.name: admin_login
ctags.pattern: /^def admin_login(client: TestClient, username: str, password: str):$/

ctags.name: admin_register
ctags.pattern: /^def admin_register(client: TestClient, username: str, password: str):$/
